title: The Trail of Coins
text: House coins lie dropped one by one along a path, glinting in the mud, a clever Scion's breadcrumbs leading off into the hills. You may not be the only ones to have found them.

options.label: Follow the coins into the hills wherever they lead.

outcomes.text: They lead on, and you pocket them one by one as you go.

options.label: The sharpest notices the spacing, and what it says of whoever dropped them.

outcomes.text: Here they fall closer together. They were running.

options.label: Hang back and watch the trail; someone else may be following them too.
